Chapter 11 of 19

The Nocturnals

East Van after dark150 BPM
The story

After sunset, somebody has to find where the night is happening before anyone else does. In Terminal City that is the Nocturnals: the night scouts. They are not a council and not a workforce. They are whatever reliably leads you to the right unmarked door.

Sometimes that is a set of tracks on a wet service road. Sometimes it is a shadow moving along a rail cut, or a coyote that seems to be waiting at exactly the right warehouse. Sometimes it is just a coincidence that keeps happening. People follow without meaning to, and they end up somewhere the wider city has not noticed yet.

The Nocturnals take over from the Sunset and lead toward the Sixth Hour. The Green Static, which confuses every scheduled system, does not confuse them. Night eyes. Follow bass. No address. They know.

Terminal City is an original fictional mythology inspired by Vancouver’s geography, weather, wildlife, infrastructure, art, and electronic music. It makes no claim to historical, Indigenous, or religious tradition. Real places are used as settings; the operating system layered on them is invented. Photograph reality. Alter the evidence. Never illustrate the whole myth.
